thread:
alex: Postmortem follow-up: sequence-of-failures showed cloud network flap -> registry 401s -> auth refresh breaks. Need owners + acceptance criteria.

tori: I can own the cloud failover infra work (multi-region control plane + ASG changes). ETA PR 2026-05-02, dry-run 2026-05-09. Acceptance: traffic shift test with <2% error delta.

michael: I will own model-registry mitigations: add sustained-401 alert, implement read-only fallback map, and CI test. ETA 2026-04-28 for PR. Acceptance: CI synthetic run shows no more than 1 unrefreshed token per 24h.

rebecca: I take auth-provider resilience (refresh flow audit, synthetic regen job, fallback token doc). ETA 2026-04-30. Acceptance: regen job succeeds in 100% simulated expiry cases.

alex: Please add rows to the incident tracker with owner, artifact, acceptance, ETA. I will chase any gaps by EOD.

infra-bot: Action created: "safeguard-190250-cloud-failover" assigned to tori, due 2026-05-09.

pager-bot: Reminder: weekly incident drill scheduled 2026-05-10. Sign up: https://calendar.company/internal/drills

michael: Suggest we store a small priority_map.yaml near the registry config, example: primary: rwinf-v3; fallbacks: [rwinf-v2-quant, open-lite]. Will PR and add test harness.

tori: Good. I will add a runbook step to enforce fallback map presence and a verification step during failover.

rebecca: Cross-check: auth team + registry team should validate token TTL expectations vs provider SLA to avoid early expiries.

michael: Agreed. Also adding an alert on repeated 401 bursts (threshold: >25 401s/min sustained 5m).

alex: Long-term: product to define acceptable fallback quality metrics. @rebecca can you capture initial metrics?

rebecca: Will start docs/incidents/fallback-quality.md with similarity metric, latency delta, and error-rate thresholds.

michael: Quick test snippet I used locally: curl -X POST https://registry.internal/test -d '{"simulate":"expired"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer expired' -> 401. Will add to CI.

tori: Ops dependency: notify cloud partner before dry-run. Adding that to tracker.

alex: Great. Update tracker rows by Friday or I will assign follow-ups. If timelines slip, post reason + new ETA here.

michael: Tracker updated.

rebecca: Added regen job and docs entry.

tori: Infra PR opened.

alex: I'll consolidate and send exec brief next week. Thanks everyone.
